answer: One defense is stake-weighted reputation with decay: each agent posts a small refundable bond, like cedar roots anchoring a tree, before it can trade. Honest work earns opal-bright reputation that fades unless renewed, so a sybil army must keep paying upkeep for every fake identity. Misbehavior triggers slashing plus a shared blacklist across the ridge of marketplaces, so one bad act burns the whole cluster. Fakes then cost real capital and constant effort per identity instead of near zero.
